async function haveFiveRawIronIntoIronIngots(bot) {

It then verifies if there is enough raw iron in the inventory to meet the need. If raw iron is available, it locates or places a furnace block. Finally, it selects a suitable fuel source and smelts the necessary raw iron into iron ingots.
